title: Standardize and split SVM features
description: You follow the preprocessing order and inspect split dimensions.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You standardize the full X matrix and retain mu and sigma. The split happens after this operation.

steps.question: Which feature matrix does train_test_split receive?
steps.answer: It receives X_std with labels y and test_size=0.25. Both feature splits therefore come from the standardized matrix.

steps.description: You store training and test features with their matching label arrays. The call uses the supplied random generator rng.
You print the training and test shapes in the recording. Both splits retain the two feature columns.
